content.text:
Rename is wired through all three layers:

- `TodoStore.rename(id, label)` — trims, ignores blank input, no-ops on an unknown id
- `TodoFeature.renameTask(id, text)` — passthrough, consistent with the other wrappers
- `renameTodoItem(item, text)` in `Todo.ts` for the render shape

I added unit tests covering rename, trimming, and the unknown-id case, and the tests are green. Type-check passes as well — build output above. Ready to use.
